title: Hearty Smoky Greek Vegetable Dolmades
description: A smoky and crunchy Greek dish featuring roasted vegetables and doubanjiang, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this lacto-vegetarian friendly recipe is formed into delicious dolmades.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the diced eggplant, zucchini, red bell pepper, and onion to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Spread the marinated vegetables on a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together doubanjiang and 1 tablespoon of water.
Add the roasted vegetables, crumbly feta cheese, and doubanjiang mixture to a food processor and pulse until coarsely chopped.
Lay a grape leaf flat on a work surface, with the stem end facing you.
Place about 1 tablespoon of the vegetable mixture in the center of the grape leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the dolma into a neat package.
Repeat with the remaining grape leaves and filling.
Serve the dolmades warm or at room temperature.
